nodes.label: fetch_queue.py\nclassify(), spatial_kind()
nodes.detail: `scripts/fetch_queue.py` reads the register files in its `FILES` list, `data_sources.json` and `data_sources_2.json`. It puts each entry in a tier by keywords in its access text, in order: an ODA topic or a mention of Dataforsyningen is held; words for closed or unverified access make it blocked; words for a registration, account, login or token make it account; words for open or key-free access make it open; an entry matching none is blocked. It reads each entry's spatial and aggregation text for position or region keywords, lists as unlocks the hypotheses an entry names that no entry in an easier tier names, names the credentials it counts as held in `HELD` (the ODA login and the Dataforsyningen token), and writes `data/derived/fetch_queue.json` and DATA_QUEUE.md.

nodes.label: oda_client.py
nodes.detail: `scripts/oda_client.py` logs in to ODA with an email address (`Login_DoLogin`) and extracts topics over SOAP from the portal's `Services.asmx`.

nodes.label: terraincheck.py:\nthe token
nodes.detail: `scripts/terraincheck.py` reads a Dataforsyningen token from a file in the home directory, outside the repository, and fetches the national elevation model's terrain over WCS. The file was present on 2026-09-11; its content was not read.

nodes.label: fetch_satellite.py:\nCopernicus Data Space
nodes.detail: `scripts/fetch_satellite.py` reads Copernicus Data Space client credentials from files in the home directory, outside the repository, and fetches with them. The files were present on 2026-09-11 (their content was not read), and `data/raw/satellite` holds what it fetched.

nodes.label: fetch_cmems.py:\nCopernicus Marine
nodes.detail: `scripts/fetch_cmems.py` reads Copernicus Marine credentials from the home directory, outside the repository. They were present on 2026-09-11 (not read), and `data/raw/cmems` holds what it fetched.

The construction lists this as a gap. Checking the Copernicus entries for these pages found them in tiers that do not fit this project's credentials.

nodes.label: Source register\n(the files the queue reads)
nodes.detail: `data/manual/data_sources.json` and `data/manual/data_sources_2.json`: one entry per source, with custodian, access, spatial, aggregation and caveat text and the hypotheses it would serve, written by whoever verified the source. Entries these pages quote: `PULS` (not public, read through an organisation's IT coordinator; its public extracts `MILJOEGIS-RBU-SAML` and `SPILDEVANDSDATA`; custodians Danmarks Miljoeportal and Miljoestyrelsen), `SPILDEVANDSDATA` (one annual volume and event count per outfall, no per-event dates or durations; published by SEGES from PULS), `NYBORG-OVERLOEB` (per-event overflow telemetry of Nyborg Forsyning, treated as request-only), `ODA-TILFOERSEL` (monthly, per marine reference polygon; the stream stations behind it separately in `ODA-STOFTRANSPORT`), `DK-DRAENKORT-AU` (made by Aarhus Universitet, DCA, for Miljoestyrelsen; no access text; the raster's distribution route not yet located), `ODA-MFS-FISK` (fish tissue; a registration and scripted extract), `DDM` (a single current-state grid, per-survey dates and accuracies composited away; custodian Klimadatastyrelsen / Danish Hydrographic Office), `ODA-CTD` (custodian DCE, Aarhus Universitet), and entries such as `L1-GAP` that record data confirmed absent.

nodes.label: The third register file

nodes.label: unlock.py
nodes.detail: `scripts/unlock.py` defines the drop-in slots, each a file name and shape under `data/dropin/` with the scripts that read it: only the CTD visit-time slot has one, `scripts/depth_clock.py`. Run without arguments it checks the shape of each dropped file (a delimited header, a line that parses as JSON, or TIFF bytes), runs the scripts that read a present slot, and rewrites IF_YOU_HAVE_THE_DATA.md; it opens no network connection. Its gated list is every entry of the register files the fetch queue reads that `classify()` does not put in the open tier.
